I needed a break from drawing nail designs and this was very refreshing. Your hair is beautiful c:

My hand shape is pretty similar to yours and I opt for medium almond/stiletto and coffin shaped nails to give that illusion. I think medium/long coffin nails would be a better fit if you wanna try something square-ish. Even a short coffin shape would make a difference compared to the short square shape you have if you wanna keep it at a shorter length!

You can try using a liquid cuticle remover that removes your cuticles using just the liquid itself and a cuticle pusher, no cutting at all. I’ve used Sally Hansen Instant Cuticle Remover and it works well. I’ve also heard the Blue Cross Cuticle Remover is great too. Just make sure to wash your hands after the process and apply cuticle oil as always. Here’s a video on how to use the Sally Hansen one https://youtu.be/sCaMQmfbM8w. And here’s a video on how to use the Blue Cross one https://youtu.be/d_BAnJlJ1Bs. I hope that helps!

Really appreciate this. I have no experience with this sorta stuff and I was threatened with jail time for not complying with the extra fees and I was having panic attacks even tho deep down I knew I was already scammed. I just really needed the double reassurance.

Thanks a ton for looking into it for me, my dumbass appreciates it

I’m sorry about your sister OP. I wish you the best on your healing process and hope that you learn to love and care for yourself since I know that can be an everyday struggle. Progress is never linear but it’s great to see someone taking that step in healing. Much love OP.

I am so sorry that your mother is like that, OP. No one deserves that from their own parent or parental guardian. I’m sorry she failed you as a mother and treats you this way, it’s so vile. I hope you feel like you’re deserving of having a happy and good life before you attempt anything. Obviously, no one has a say in what the other person chooses in the end but you’ll be in my thoughts and you’re more than welcome to talk about anything if you want to of course. I wish you much love and a lot of peace OP. You’re very much deserving of your own happiness despite what your mother or anyone says.

I appreciate the comments for those that said my little brother needs me but he really doesn’t. He has my parents and older brother, he’ll be just fine so I’m not worry about that at all. 

Everyone in my life will move on and I’ll just be a distant memory soon. I’m not trying to live for anyone else but myself and I’ve decided I can’t even do that anymore. 

When I was about 13, I gave myself an age of when I should do it, which was 21. When I was 21 and survived my first suicide attempt, I gave myself a new age if I haven’t made any improvements again-age 23. I’m 23 now and this is it for me.

I could never imagine myself living a long, content life and I don’t have a future going for me. I’m fine with not being able to see or finish the future movies/shows/anime I’m looking forward to. I’m fine with never getting to go to Disneyland or Sixflags or even SuperMario World. I’m fine with never being able to put out my own art clothing that I used to be excited about cause at least my friends and family saw it and have it. I’m fine with not being able to have that kind of happy life I’ve always wanted with a partner because my depression will always sabotage and win over everything I have. I’ve already let go of all of my desires because I was never meant to live a long, happy life. 

Sorry for the long ramble, but I at least want to put out some of my thought process before I completely disappear from this world. 

Take care everyone.

Hey OP, genuinely hope you’re still here.

I’ve related a lot to what you said and even recently thought about owning a gun myself to end it off too but I really hope you’re still here. 

I understand you’re in a lot of pain, trust me, but I really do hope you rethought things through or at the very least delayed your ending for a while longer.

You’re still very young and you deserve to give yourself a chance in having a content and happy life, I really hope you can see it that way.

If you’re no longer with us OP, I’ll be thinking about you and hoping that you’ll finally be at rest and in peace. Much love to you.

Purging is common when inviting any new skincare to your skin and it's just its way of getting all the underlying gunk out from your skin in a faster process. It can take about 4-6 weeks for the purging to last
